newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midwest hogs seen mostly up $0.50 - dealers.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midwest hogs seen mostly up $0.50 - dealers.

text.p: Midwest cash hog prices Friday were seen mostly $0.50 per cwt higher, supported by continued strong demand from packers looking to put together a Saturday kill, livestock dealers said.
Top prices in Iowa and southern Minnesota for hogs delivered to the plant could range from $54.00 to $54.50 per cwt. Illinois top values could range from $55.00 to $55.50 at the plant gate.
Ohio/Indiana top prices were seen at $53.50 to $54.00 for hogs shipped to plants.

Active pork sales the past two days, coupled with an expected bounce in closing wholesale pork prices Thursday, led by pork bellies, was spurring the interest for a large Saturday slaughter, sources said
"We still need hogs for Saturday, but we're getting closer," one Indiana packer buyer said.
Early estimates for Saturday slaughter ranged from 100,000 to 125,000 head, the market sources said.
